'''Madan Rao''' (born 11 July 1960) is an Indian condensed matter and biological physicist and a senior professor at [[National Centre for Biological Sciences]]. Known for his research on molecular dynamics on cell surface, Rao is an elected fellow of the [[Indian Academy of Sciences]] and the [[Indian National Science Academy]]. The [[Council of Scientific and Industrial Research]], the apex agency of the Government of India for scientific research, awarded him the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize for Science and Technology]], one of the highest Indian science awards, for his contributions to physical sciences in 2004.<ref name="View Bhatnagar Awardees">{{Cite web |url=http://ssbprize.gov.in/Content/AwardeeList.aspx |title=View Bhatnagar Awardees |date=2017-11-11 |publisher=Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize |access-date=2017-11-11}}</ref>{{Refn|group=note|Long link - please select award year to see details}}

== Biography ==
[[File:IITBMainBuildingCROP.jpg|thumb|250px|left|IIT Bombay]]
Born on 11 July 1960, Madan Rao did his master's studies at the [[Indian Institute of Technology, Bombay]] to earn an MSc in physics in 1982 and proceeded to do his doctoral studies on ''Hysteresis in Model Spin Systems'' at the [[Indian Institute of Science]] under the guidance of [[H. R. Krishnamurthy]] and [[Rahul Pandit]], Both [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize|Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar laureates]].<ref name="Madan Rao - Distinguished Alumnus 2016">{{Cite web |url=http://www.iitb.ac.in/alumni/en/awards/2016/distinguished-alumnus/prof-madan-rao |title=Madan Rao - Distinguished Alumnus 2016 |date=2017-10-22 |website=Indian Institute of Technology, Bombay |access-date=2017-10-22}}</ref> After securing a PhD in 1988, he continued at IISc to do his post-doctoral work, mentored by M. Wortis, in the disciplines of membranes, [[soft matter]] and non-equilibrium statistical mechanics. Hr started his career as an associate professor at [[Raman Research Institute]] in 1989 and moved to the [[National Centre for Biological Sciences]], a centre for advanced studies on biological research, when "Simon's Centre for the Study of Living Machines", then known as "Theory Group", was established there, where he holds the position of a senior professor.<ref name="Faculty - Simon's at NCBS">{{Cite web |url=https://theory.ncbs.res.in/team/faculty |title=Faculty - Simons at NCBS |date=2017-10-22 |website=Simons Centre for the Study of Living Machines |access-date=2017-10-22}}</ref> At NCBS, he works in close association with [[Satyajit Mayor]], a biologist and a [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize|Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar laureate]].<ref name="NCBS welcomes Dr. Madan Rao as a faculty member">{{Cite web |url=http://news.ncbs.res.in/archivednews/story/ncbs-welcomes-dr-madan-rao-faculty-member |title=NCBS welcomes Dr. Madan Rao as a faculty member |date=2017-10-22 |website=NCBS News |access-date=2017-10-22}}</ref> He is also associated with the International Centre for Theoretical Sciences of [[Tata Institute of Fundamental Research]] as an associate faculty.<ref name="ASSOCIATED FACULTY  Madan Rao">{{Cite web |url=https://www.icts.res.in/people/madan-rao |title=ASSOCIATED FACULTY Madan Rao |date=2017-10-22 |website=International Centre for Theoretical Sciences |access-date=2017-10-22}}</ref>

Rao lives in [[Bengaluru]], in the south Indian state of [[Karnataka]].<ref name="Madan Rao  Professor  Theoretical Condensed Matter / Biological Physics">{{Cite web |url=http://www.rri.res.in/~madan/ |title=Madan Rao Professor Theoretical Condensed Matter / Biological Physics |date=2017-10-22 |website=Raman Research Institute |access-date=2017-10-22}}</ref>

== Legacy ==
At NCBS, Rao worked on non-equilibrium properties of [[Biological membrane|membrane]]s and [[martensitic transformation]]<ref name="Brief Profile of the Awardee">{{Cite web |url=http://ssbprize.gov.in/content/Detail.aspx?AID=8 |title=Brief Profile of the Awardee |date=2017-10-21 |publisher=Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize |access-date=2017-10-21}}</ref> and is known to have made significant contributions in providing a wider understanding of ''chirality-induced budding and dynamics of intracellular trafficking''.<ref name="Handbook of Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize Winners">{{Cite web |url=http://www.csirhrdg.res.in/ssb.pdf |title=Handbook of Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize Winners |date=2017-10-17 |publisher=Council of Scientific and Industrial Research |access-date=2017-10-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304043957/http://www.csirhrdg.res.in/ssb.pdf |archive-date=4 March 2016 }}</ref> Molecular dynamics at cell surface, membrane dynamics, [[Golgi cell|golgi]] and [[mitochondrial]] [[morphogenesis]], [[chromatin|chromatin organization]], soft active matter physics and biomolecular dynamics are some of the other areas he has worked on.<ref name="THEORETICAL APPROACHES IN CELL BIOLOGY">{{Cite web |url=https://www.ncbs.res.in/faculty/madan |title=THEORETICAL APPROACHES IN CELL BIOLOGY |date=2017-10-22 |website=NCBS |access-date=2017-10-22}}</ref> His studies have been documented by way of a number of articles<ref name="On ResearchGate">{{Cite web |url=https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Madan_Rao2 |title=On ResearchGate |date=2017-10-17 |access-date=2017-10-17}}</ref>{{Refn|group=note|Please see ''Selected bibliography'' section}} and the online article repository of the Indian Academy of Sciences has listed 33 of them.<ref name="Browse by Fellow">{{Cite web |url=http://repository.ias.ac.in/view/fellows/Rao=3AMadan=3A=3A.html |title=Browse by Fellow |date=2017-10-21 |publisher=Indian Academy of Sciences |access-date=2017-10-21}}</ref> He was also a member of the organizing committee of the ''Conference on Frontiers in Materials Modelling and Design'' held in Kalpakkam in 1996.<ref name="KumarSengupta2012">{{cite book|author1=Vijay Kumar|author2=Surajit Sengupta|author3=Baldev Raj|title=Frontiers in Materials Modelling and Design: Proceedings of the Conference on Frontiers in Materials Modelling and Design, Kalpakkam, 20–23 August 1996|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=5gDtCAAAQBAJ&pg=PR6|date=6 December 2012|publisher=Springer Science & Business Media|isbn=978-3-642-80478-6|pages=6–}}</ref>

== Awards and honors ==
B. M. Birla Science Centre awarded Rao their annual B. M. Birla Science Prize in 1997<ref name="B. M. Birla Science Prize">{{Cite web |url=http://www.birlasciencecentre.org/awards/birlaSciencePrizes/ |title=B. M. Birla Science Prize |date=2017-10-23 |website=B. M. Birla Science Centre |access-date=2017-10-23 |archive-date=28 January 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180128175901/http://www.birlasciencecentre.org/awards/birlaSciencePrizes/ }}</ref> and he received the Swarnajayanti Fellowship of the [[Department of Science and Technology (India)|Department of Science and Technology]] in 1998. The Council of Scientific and Industrial Research awarded him the [[Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar Prize]], one of the highest Indian science awards in 2004.<ref name="CSIR list of Awardees">{{Cite web |url=http://www.csir.res.in/careeraward/prize-winner-indexdiscipline-wise |title=CSIR list of Awardees |date=2017 |publisher=Council of Scientific and Industrial Research}}</ref> During 2007–11, he received two research fellowships; Human Frontier Science Program (HFSP) Grant (2007)<ref name="Yamuna Krishnan and collaborators awarded HFSP 2014 research grant">{{Cite web |url=http://news.ncbs.res.in/archivednews/story/yamuna-krishnan-and-collaborators-awarded-hfsp-2014-research-grant |title=Yamuna Krishnan and collaborators awarded HFSP 2014 research grant |date=31 March 2014 |website=National Centre for Biological Sciences |access-date=2017-10-23}}</ref> as well as the Indo-French Centre for the Promotion of Advanced Research (CEFIPRA) Grant.<ref name="Madan Rao - Distinguished Alumnus 2016" /><ref name="Awarded Grants">{{Cite web |url=https://www.ncbs.res.in/sites/default/files/users/malinisp/June%20Funding%20Horizons%20newsletter_%20060617_Reduced.pdf |title=Awarded Grants |date=June 2017 |website=NCBS |access-date=2017-10-23}}</ref> The Indian Academy of Sciences elected him as a fellow in 2011<ref name="Fellow profile">{{Cite web |url=http://www.ias.ac.in/describe/fellow/Rao,_Prof._Madan |title=Fellow profile |date=2017-10-21 |publisher=Indian Academy of Sciences |access-date=2017-10-22}}</ref> and his alma mater, the [[Indian Institute of Technology, Mumbai]] chose his as a Distinguished Alumnus in 2016.<ref name="Prof. Madan Rao wins distinguished alumnus award">{{Cite web |url=http://www.phy.iitb.ac.in/en/content/prof-madan-rao-wins-distinguished-alumnus-award |title=Prof. Madan Rao wins distinguished alumnus award |date=2017-10-23 |website=IIT Bombay |access-date=2017-10-23}}</ref> He received the elected fellowship of the [[Indian National Science Academy]] in 2017.<ref name="Indian fellow">{{Cite web |url=http://insaindia.res.in/detail/P17-1758 |title=Indian fellow |date=2017-10-21 |publisher=Indian National Science Academy |access-date=2017-10-22}}</ref>
